answer: Sybil resistance can come from a 'quill trail' audit: every new identity must publish its first ten interactions, and validators replay those actions to see whether writing style, latency spikes and IP/ASN cadence cluster with existing accounts. A ferrous-hard rule follows: if two nominally separate agents share more than sixty percent of their arrival-time fingerprint, both are fused into one census slot. Honest operators reach the network's zenith by staying legible, while farms collapse because synthetic authors cannot fake divergent behavioral noise forever.
